headline: A meteorite hits a woman in Alabama

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen fifty-four... a rock from space fell on a sleeping woman.

scenes.label: Sylacauga, Alabama
scenes.caption: Ann Hodges and the hole in her roof, 1954
scenes.title: Through the roof
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] It smashed through her roof in Sylacauga, Alabama, and bounced off her radio.

scenes.label: the meteorite that hit her
scenes.text: [calmly] The meteorite weighed about eight and a half pounds.

scenes.label: Ann Hodges
scenes.caption: Holding the meteorite, 1954
scenes.title: Bruised, but alive
scenes.text: [softly] Ann Hodges was left badly bruised... but alive.

scenes.title: The first person known hurt by a meteorite
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] She became the first person known to be hurt by a meteorite.
